description: This file defines the EdgeDao interface for data access operations related to 'Edge' entities within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for saving, querying, and retrieving edge-related data.

classes.name: EdgeDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Edge entities, extending generic DAO and tenant-specific DAO interfaces.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an Edge entity for a specific tenant.

methods.name: findEdgeInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves EdgeInfo by tenant ID and edge UUID.

methods.name: findActiveEdges
methods.description: Finds all active edges with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgeIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Finds edge IDs by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds edges by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds edges by tenant ID and type with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds edges by tenant ID and list of edge UUIDs.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds edges by tenant ID and customer ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds edges by tenant ID, customer ID, and type with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgeInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds EdgeInfo objects by tenant ID and customer ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgeInfosByTenantIdAndCustomerIdAndType
methods.description: Finds EdgeInfo objects by tenant ID, customer ID, and type with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantIdCustomerIdAndIdsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds edges by tenant ID, customer ID, and list of UUIDs.

methods.name: findEdgeByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds an edge by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findTenantEdgeTypesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves edge types for a tenant.

methods.name: findByRoutingKey
methods.description: Finds an edge by tenant ID and routing key.

methods.name: findEdgeInfosByTenantIdAndType
methods.description: Finds EdgeInfo objects by tenant ID and type with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgeInfosByTenantId
methods.description: Finds EdgeInfo objects by tenant ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantIdAndEntityId
methods.description: Finds edges by tenant ID and associated entity ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgeIdsByTenantIdAndEntityId
methods.description: Finds edge IDs by tenant ID and entity ID with pagination.

methods.name: findEdgesByTenantProfileId
methods.description: Finds edges by tenant profile ID with pagination.
